attestations.text: LIU Pao-nan 劉寶楠 (T. 楚楨, H. 念樓), Mar. 9, 1791–1855, Nov. 13, scholar and official, was a native of Pao-ying, Kiangsu. His father, Liu Li-hsün 劉履恂 (T. 廸九, H. 雲陔, 1738–1795), a cousin of Liu T'ai-kung [q. v.], was given late in life the rank of archivist of the Imperial Academy.

accounts.evidence: 劉寶楠，字楚楨，寶應人。父履恂，字迪九，乾隆五十一年舉人，國子監典簿，著有秋槎札記。
